front.title: The Ego Hijack
front.copy: You replace their story with your own and compete in suffering.

back.title: Protocol
back.copy: Stop talking. Ask questions and listen until they feel fully heard.

front.title: The "No" Override
front.copy: You hear "no" and retreat instead of getting curious.

back.title: Protocol
back.copy: Stay calm. Ask: "Why no?" and "What would make this a yes?"

front.title: BLUF Protocol
front.copy: You hide your main point in a long story.

back.title: Protocol
back.copy: Start with your conclusion in one sentence. Then give only key reasons.

front.title: SYN-ACK Handshake
front.copy: You drop heavy truth before checking if they are really listening.

back.title: Protocol
back.copy: Test the link: share a small piece, ask how it lands, then go deeper.

front.title: The 280-Word Gap
front.copy: Your brain writes replies instead of listening.

back.title: Protocol
back.copy: Force a pause. After they talk, first repeat what you heard, then respond.

front.title: Infinite Warfare
front.copy: You try to win the argument and lose the relationship.

back.title: Protocol
back.copy: Aim to keep the person, not win the point. Look for shared ground.

front.title: The Binary Trap
front.copy: You ask yes/no questions and get shallow answers.

back.title: Protocol
back.copy: Use "How…" and "What…" questions to pull out a full story.

front.title: Zero-Day Vulnerability
front.copy: You fake knowing instead of saying "I don’t know."

back.title: Protocol
back.copy: Admit it. Say what you will do to find the answer, and by when.

front.title: Signal-to-Noise
front.copy: You mix emotion and bias into technical info.

back.title: Protocol
back.copy: Separate facts, opinions, and feelings into clear lanes.

front.title: The Flight Instinct
front.copy: Rejection feels like danger, so you run.

back.title: Protocol
back.copy: Name the feeling. Stay in the talk long enough to learn from it.

front.title: Hidden State Sync
front.copy: You guess what they mean instead of decoding it.

back.title: Protocol
back.copy: Listen for values and fears under the words. Ask: "Did I get that right?"

front.title: Audience Mismatch
front.copy: You speak in a format the other person can’t read.

back.title: Protocol
back.copy: Detect their level and role, then translate your idea into their language.
